visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed muted looping background video with overlaid eyebrow, title (text or image) and CTAs

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = link to an .mp4/.webm video plus optional poster picture; cell 2 = eyebrow, heading or title image, CTA links

reuseGuidance: Use only where the source has a background video. Video does not autoplay with prefers-reduced-motion; a play/pause toggle is always rendered.
